program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((bg (mode g))
                  (colors (grid-colors g bg))
                  (entries (map (lambda (color)
                                  (list (length (find-color g color)) color))
                                colors))
                  (sorted (sort entries > #:key first))
                  (big (first sorted))
                  (big-n (first big))
                  (big-color (second big))
                  (repeated (filter (lambda (entry) (> (first entry) 1)) (rest sorted)))
                  (small (if (empty? repeated) #f (first repeated)))
                  (small-n (if small (first small) 0))
                  (small-color (if small (second small) bg))
                  (single (find-first (lambda (entry) (= (first entry) 1)) entries))
                  (single-color (if single (second single) bg))
                  (square-side (lambda (n)
                                 (find-first (lambda (i) (= (* i i) n))
                                             (range 1 (+ n 1)))))
                  (big-side (square-side big-n))
                  (small-side (if small (square-side small-n) 0))
                  (out-h (max big-side (+ small-side (if single 1 0))))
                  (small-c (if single 2 0))
                  (big-c (+ small-c small-side 1))
                  (out-w (+ big-c big-side))
                  (small-r (- out-h small-side)))
             (build-grid out-h
                         out-w
                         (r c)
                         (cond
                           ((and (< r big-side) (>= c big-c) (< c (+ big-c big-side))) big-color)
                           ((and
                              small
                              (>= r small-r)
                              (>= c small-c)
                              (< c (+ small-c small-side))) small-color)
                           ((and single (= r (- out-h 1)) (zero? c)) single-color)
                           (else bg)))))))
